subject: Sundial renewal + expansion — bakeoff readout & proposal
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Evelyn Sanders <evelyn.sanders@sundialretail.com>, Mark Chen <mark.chen@sundialretail.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Sundial renewal + expansion — bakeoff readout & proposal

Evelyn / Mark —

Thanks again for hosting the bakeoff last week and walking us through the traffic patterns and latency targets. We heard from your engineering team that the competing vendor met baseline throughput but struggled with tail latency during promotional bursts — we believe Redwood can address that without a large term uplift.

Quick summary of what we propose next:
- Share the benchmark artifacts (we'll attach the end-to-end perf report) so your infra team can validate results.
- Lock a pilot commitment to validate prefix caching across your busiest endpoints (2–3 week run).
- Offer an expansion package to cover the Q4 promotional window (capacity buffer + priority scheduling) with a 12‑month renewal at a blended rate (details attached).

Can we schedule a 30‑minute readout with your engineering and procurement leads next week? Suggested times: Tue/Wed 10–12 PT.

Thanks — we want to make the decision low-risk and provide a predictable path to the capacity you need.

Best,
Priyom Das
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
pri_yom@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0172

Attachments: (will send benchmark summary + MAP after internal sync)
From: Evelyn Sanders <evelyn.sanders@sundialretail.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Mark Chen <mark.chen@sundialretail.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sundial renewal + expansion — bakeoff readout & proposal

Thanks, Priyom — appreciate the fast follow. Quick clarifying Qs before we book time:

1) The exec team asked whether Redwood's bundle includes an SLA for promotional tail latency (p95/p99) and what the proposed credits look like if we see regressions.
2) Procurement will want an outline of term/discount thresholds tied to committed throughput.
3) Our infra lead also wants the raw perf logs for the burst window (04/15 promo). Can you provide those?

If you can send the perf artifacts and a one‑pager on the SLA/credits, we'll loop in our platform and procurement and pick a time. Tue 10:30 PT works for Mark and me.

—Evelyn
Evelyn Sanders
VP Platform | Sundial Retail
Evelyn.Sanders@sundialretail.com
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Evelyn Sanders <evelyn.sanders@sundialretail.com>, Mark Chen <mark.chen@sundialretail.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 12:00:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: Sundial follow-up — SLA language + perf artifacts (please review before 10:30 PT Tue)

Team — looping you in. Evelyn asked for three deliverables for the Tue readout:
1) Raw perf logs for the 04/15 promo burst + annotated summary.
2) Proposed SLA language for promotional tail latency with credit schedule.
3) Pricing thresholds for a 12‑month renewal with a Q4 capacity buffer (we need a couple of options).

Karthik: can you package the perf logs + a short note on how prefix caching/KV cache reduces p99 under burst? Keep it ~1 page with graphs.
Laura: can you draft the MAP and the contract milestones (pilot sign-off, pilot completion, production cutover)? Put alternatives for a 6‑month vs 12‑month commitment.
Rohan: can you confirm current capacity headroom and whether we can offer a modest priority-scheduling slot for their promo window (estimate extra 20% capacity at reserved pricing)?

I'll consolidate and send to Evelyn by EOD Monday so they have time to review before Tue. If anyone needs more time, call me.

Thanks — Priyom
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Evelyn Sanders <evelyn.sanders@sundialretail.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Rohan Mehta <rohan_mehta@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 09:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sundial renewal + expansion — bakeoff readout & proposal

Evelyn —
Attaching the benchmark summary and a short technical note. Highlights up front:
- The competing vendor hit throughput at baseline but experienced a 2.8x p99 increase during burst windows due to KV cache eviction under concurrent sessions.
- Our continuous batching + per-session KV cache kept p99 within 1.15x of steady-state for the same workload; end-to-end latency improvements were most notable when token sequence variance was high (promo content + user-generated metadata).
- Suggested pilot config: 2 dedicated instances with prefix caching enabled, 1-week smoke + 2-week steady-state run; we'll stream metrics to your Grafana.

Attachments: redwood-benchmark-sundial-v2.pdf (perf logs + charts), rdw-sla-sample.txt (SLA language draft)

Karthik Iyer
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com

Evelyn / Mark —

Appended is a concise package for your review ahead of Tue 10:30 PT:
- redwood-benchmark-sundial-v2.pdf (perf logs + annotated charts)
- rdw-sla-sample.txt (SLA language + credit schedule focused on promo windows)
- mutual-action-plan-sundial.xlsx (pilot milestones, acceptance criteria, contract timing)

High-level offers (choose A/B):
A) 12‑month renewal + expansion (preferred)
  - Committed throughput: 30M tokens/mo baseline + 25% promo buffer
  - Pricing: blended rate with 15% renewal discount
  - SLA: p99 credit applicable if p99 during promo > baseline * 1.4 for two successive promo days
  - Included: priority scheduling (one reserved burst slot per promo day)

B) 6‑month pilot + 12‑month option
  - Pilot pricing at standard rate; production uplift subject to committed throughput after pilot

Next steps:
1) Confirm Tue 10:30 PT for the readout (we'll send a calendar invite after you confirm).
2) If option A is interesting, Mark — can you share procurement's target approval timeline and any required PO templates?
3) We can prep a DocuSign packet overnight if you want to accelerate.

Thanks again — we want this to be a straightforward decision for your team; the MAP has clear exit criteria if the pilot doesn't meet the p99 targets.

Best,
Priyom Das
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
